description: A range keeps the two most recent tickets of a live instance list
code:
class Ticket(code):
    this.code = code
a = Ticket("A1")
b = Ticket("B2")
c = Ticket("C3")
recent = Ticket[-2:].map(ticket => ticket.code)
assert(recent, ["B2", "C3"])
d = Ticket("D4")
assert(recent, ["C3", "D4"])
recent

description: Listing every instance with list and all follows newly created sensors
code:
class Sensor(room):
    this.room = room
kitchen = Sensor("kitchen")
hall = Sensor("hall")
rooms = Sensor.list().map(sensor => sensor.room)
count = Sensor.all().length
porch = Sensor("porch")
assert(rooms, ["kitchen", "hall", "porch"])
assert(count, 3)
rooms

description: at reads the newest and previous readings from the end of a growing list
code:
readings = [18, 21]
latest = readings.at(-1)
previous = readings.at(-2)
readings.push(25)
assert(latest, 25)
assert(previous, 21)
latest

description: findLast and findLastIndex locate the most recent failed check
code:
class Check(name, passed):
    this.name = name
    this.passed = passed
lint = Check("lint", false)
unit = Check("unit", true)
build = Check("build", false)
lastFailure = Check.findLast(check => not check.passed).name
position = Check.findLastIndex(check => not check.passed)
assert(lastFailure, "build")
assert(position, 2)
build.passed = true
assert(lastFailure, "lint")
assert(position, 0)
lastFailure

description: findIndex and lastIndexOf report live positions or minus one
code:
queue = ["ana", "ben", "ana"]
firstLong = queue.findIndex(name => name.length > 3)
lastAna = queue.lastIndexOf("ana")
assert(firstLong, -1)
assert(lastAna, 2)
queue.push("carla")
assert(firstLong, 3)
[firstLong, lastAna]

description: Concatenating an instance list read with list joins two populations
code:
class Staff
class Guest
host = Staff()
ana = Guest()
ben = Guest()
everyone = Staff.concat(Guest.list())
assert(everyone, [host, ana, ben])
cal = Guest()
assert(everyone.length, 4)
everyone.length

description: A class level rule keeps each team roster as a live range of players
code:
class Player(name):
    this.name = name
class Team(size):
    this.size = size
$Team.roster = Player[0:$Team.size].map(player => player.name)
ana = Player("Ana")
ben = Player("Ben")
cal = Player("Cal")
starters = Team(2)
assert(starters.roster, ["Ana", "Ben"])
starters.size = 3
starters.roster
